evidence_id_format.pilot_run_id_description: Unique identifier of the pilot run, assigned by the pilot operator.

evidence_type_definitions.run_log: Run logs (start time, end time, run-time warnings, model output).
evidence_type_definitions.validation_record: Validation records (expected vs observed, per metric, per B3 area).
evidence_type_definitions.screenshot: Screenshots of the user-facing run when they document something the run logs do not.
evidence_type_definitions.user_feedback: User feedback per the B7 pilot user feedback protocol (anonymized).
evidence_type_definitions.issue_log: Issue log entries (the B20 issue log template entries themselves).
evidence_type_definitions.no_go_acknowledgement: Signed no-go acknowledgement by pilot user and operator.
evidence_type_definitions.other: Any other evidence not covered above, with notes.

sensitivity_taxonomy.public: No redaction required. May be shared in any context.
sensitivity_taxonomy.internal: Internal use only. May be shared within the project team. Not for external use.
sensitivity_taxonomy.confidential: Sensitive. May be shared with the project lead, the pilot operator, and the B-track owner. Not for reviewer-facing or external use.
sensitivity_taxonomy.restricted: Highly sensitive. May be shared with the project lead only. Includes any pilot user data, any production data references, any NDA-protected data, any security incident details.

retention_policy.summary: Per the B7 pilot user feedback protocol. Default retention is the duration of the pilot run window plus 90 days, unless the pilot scope or the project lead specifies a different retention.
retention_policy.notes: Confidential and restricted evidence (e.g. pilot user data) is retained per the protocol and is not used in any external-claim language, in any marketing material, in any sales conversation, or in any external review document, without the pilot user's explicit written consent.

global_notes: This template is empty at package creation. It is populated only when a controlled pilot has actually run. Do not claim a pilot has happened unless actual pilot results are later provided. Do not invent evidence. Do not pre-populate the template with hypothetical evidence.
Pilot evidence is internal. It is not external validation, not a customer reference, and is not used in marketing or sales without the pilot user's explicit written consent.

Claude review is separate. The Phase 51N checkpoint includes a Claude review preparation pack on the Agent A side; Claude review itself is handled outside this branch and is not represented in B20 as completed.
Each evidence item has a SHA-256 checksum, a size in bytes, a creation timestamp, and a retention-until date. The retention policy is per docs/pilot/pilot_user_feedback_protocol.md §5.
Confidential and restricted evidence (e.g. pilot user data) is handled per the B7 protocol and is not used in any external-claim language without the pilot user's explicit written consent.
